title: Dark Figures Composition
coreRelationships: Central male figure as a focal point amidst a multitude of surrounding female figures.
High contrast between illuminated skin/clothing and deep shadows.
Overlapping and intertwined arrangement of bodies creating a dense texture.
Repetitive use of black and dark tones across all elements.
Subtle variations in skin tone and clothing texture against the uniform dark background.
reuseFormula: Generate a dark, high-contrast photographic composite. Place a male figure in dark, formal attire and sunglasses centrally. Overlay the standard 'Parental Advisory' label at the bottom center.
